attributes.name: pill chip link treatment
attributes.definition: Whether and how links or category items are presented as small rounded pill-shaped chips.

values.definition: Pill chips with a visible outline/border and transparent or plain fill.
Pill chips with a semi-transparent filled background.
Pill-shaped chips without a stated outline or translucency, e.g. filter pills.
Links are not styled as pills.

attributes.name: pill chip function
attributes.definition: The purpose the pill chips serve on the page.

values.definition: Pills that narrow or filter a content grid or list.
Pills that link to topics, categories, or locations.
Pills presenting suggested or related links, often after a label.
Pills forming a general group of links under a heading.

attributes.name: pill placement and context
attributes.definition: Where the pill group sits relative to surrounding content and its background.

values.definition: Left-aligned beneath a heading on a plain background.
Positioned above a grid or list of content.
Follows a small label on the same line or block.
